categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and src/zmq/ paths, altering ZMQ notification initialization and error reporting.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent failure where bitcoind starts normally despite failing to bind configured ZMQ sockets. As noted in issue #33715, bind failures were previously swallowed in debug logs, leaving operators unaware that notifications were disabled.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Excluded: changes to src/init.cpp merely propagate ZMQ's error result, and changes whose point is one area's behavior are not utils.
categories.rationale: Touches init.cpp only to handle ZMQ initialization failure.
